name: filterName
label: Filter label
description: A meaningful name for the filter that is visible for the user

name: filterCustomId
label: Filter Custom Id
description: A custom identifier for the filter

name: filterComponentType
label: Filter type
description: The type of data that will be filtered. Other configuration options vary based on this value.

name: targets
label: Data to filter
description: Define to which data the filter will be applied to and how

name: allowedDateRanges
label: Dynamic date ranges
description: List of allowed presets for dynamic date range selection

name: defaultSelectedItems
label: Default values
description: Select default values for the filter. Can be used if you want the user to open the page with some filter(s) already applied.

name: cascadingConfig
label: Cascading configuration
description: Cascading configurations that stores what filters the filter is following

name: defaultSelectedDateRange
label: Default values
description: Select default values for the filter. Can be used if you want the user to open the page with some filter(s) already applied.

name: defaultDateStart
label: Start date
description: Custom start date to be applied to filter

name: defaultDateEnd
label: End date
description: Custom end date to be applied to filter

name: allowTimeSelection
label: Allow time selection
description: When enabled user can specify hours and minutes in addition to date

name: dateFilterView
label: Date filter view
description: Determines how the date filter will be displayed

name: defaultBoolean
label: Default value
description: Select default values for the filter. Can be used if you want the user to open the page with some filter(s) already applied.

name: filterElementType
label: Filter Element
description: The visual element for selecting the filter value.

name: isShowSelectedValueInPill
label: Show values in pill
description: Show the selected filter elements inside the pill

name: filterElementLayout
label: Layout
description: How the elements to choose from are displayed. You may need to resize the filter after changing the layout.

name: enableResetToDefault
label: Allow reset to default
description: Allow user to reset filters to default values

name: enableClearFilter
label: Allow user to clear filter
description: Allows user to clear all filter values they had selected. Can be useful when user must select at least one value.

name: primaryActionLabel
label: Primary action button label
description: Label for the button that accepts a choice made about a filter (Default: 'Apply')

name: maxElements
label: Number of elements to load
description: Pills load in batches as needed. For pills, this number is the page size of each batch. For typeahead, this number is the total number of results to load.

name: cascadeScope
label: Filter scope used to determine whether a filter can be cascaded by other filters

name: isDashboard
description: Indicates whether the filter group is rendered in a dashboard

name: isGroup
label: Indicates whether the filter is rendered inside a group
